title: Practicing Chants
content: Aware are you? you are telling a person have you acknowledge me, lets practice this when someone is absent say ,aware are you, any response is good and should be positive.Hi I greet my friends lets start this exercise to chant our word and reuse words is the best way to make yourself authentic and in this practice you may gain Aura if you know what that means.So lets chant ,breath in breath out cycles first lets breath in through our nose then breath out through our mouth do this three times then lets chant our words.first chant, making it happen! voice this out loud three times ok you got the hang of it.Lets continue our work when you breath in through your nose say,making it happen, through your mouth and when you do this thats one cycle, so for your next task repeat this four times.

title: Monday chants!
content: Theres away to make your voice change and this is by following my guide in the first session you tested out something that interests me, in the next we are also going to try out something so on our way of doing things we shall commit to our word. lets start deep breath in through nose and breath out through mouth slowly do this three times as a warm up are you done, our next task is to say the sentence, we are up! say this sentence as you breath out then do it for me three times, do it in the morning and evening you will get the picture when we reach Friday.

title: Tuesday chants!
content: Hey back again you did the Monday chants and you are interested in Tuesdays sentence like usual we begin the day by morning chant with a warm-up this usually takes three breathing cycles in then out breath the first warm-up next we going to use a word this is, Bless you believe! say this sentence as I breath out breath in and breath out say, Bless you believe! Repeat these words three times as you speak your building momentum for your raspy voice taste that mana.Get the day correct and you will see the power remember to do it in the afternoon aswell, we are going up until Friday...

title: Wednesday chants!
content: So we have come far only two days stay for our next session which is Wednesday we will do the same practice and this practice we will mean it let's begin take a breath in and out do it again three times as your warm-up this is the first thing when we begin chanting and it allows our inner thought to be free also I adjust the vocal to make more crispy voice so let's begin breath in and say out loud, we shall begin say, take knowledge in this is important say this the final, We trust you! three times repeat it hey. wait for Thursday!?
